description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest' which tests the functionality of 'EmpEmergencyContactDao' within the OrangeHRM project. The tests cover CRUD operations and search functionalities related to employee emergency contacts in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test case for 'EmpEmergencyContactDao' testing CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and populates test data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee emergency contact.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithSeqNo
methods.description: Tests saving an emergency contact with a specific sequence number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEmergencyContactWithInvalidSeqNo
methods.description: Tests that saving an emergency contact with an invalid sequence number throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific emergency contact by employee ID and sequence number.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple emergency contacts for an employee.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Tests searching for emergency contacts using filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Tests counting emergency contacts matching filter criteria.
